 Paul Bettany & Owen Wilson To Appear On “Jimmy Kimmel Live” 
 October 24, 2026 
 Roger Palmer 
 Disney has announced details on next week’s lineup of “Jimmy Kimmel Live”, which airs every weeknight at 11:35 p.m. EDT and features a diverse lineup of guests that includes celebrities, athletes, musical acts, comedians and human-interest subjects, along with comedy bits and a house band.
 Here’s a look at who will appear on “Jimmy Kimmel Live” next week:
 Monday, Oct. 26
 1. Dave Grohl (“Your Favorite Toy”) 2. Connie Britton (“Phony”) 3. Musical Guest Foo Fighters (“Your Favorite Toy”) 4. Nayanna Holley sits in with The Cletones
 Tuesday, Oct. 27
 1. Owen Wilson (“Stick”) 2. Gabourey Sidibe (“American Horror Story”) 3. Musical Guest Foo Fighters (“Your Favorite Toy”) 4. Nayanna Holley sits in with The Cletones
 Wednesday, Oct. 28
 1. Gov. Gavin Newsom (D-Calif.) 2. Emma Roberts (“American Horror Story”) 3. Musical Guest Foo Fighters (“Your Favorite Toy”) 4. Nayanna Holley sits in with The Cletones
 Thursday, Oct. 29
 1. Paul Bettany (“VisionQuest”) 2. Christopher Lloyd (“In My Own Time”) 3. Musical Guest Foo Fighters (“Your Favorite Toy”) 4. Nayanna Holley sits in with The Cletones
 Jimmy Kimmel, Erin Irwin, Molly McNearney, Jennifer Sharron and David Craig serve as executive producers; Douglas DeLuca serves as co-executive producer. “Jimmy Kimmel Live” is produced by 12:05 AM Productions, LLC, in association with KIMMELOT and 20th Television.
 “Jimmy Kimmel Live” airs every weeknight at 11:35 p.m. ET on ABC, and it streams the next day on Hulu and Hulu On Disney+.
